Subject: Custody Corridor — Handoff & Implementation Overview

Team —

Quick handoff for the Corridor Finance deal (RDW-2026-459). We closed last week; Emma and Procurement are looped in for visibility. Below is the short playbook and ownership ask so CS can pick up execution.

Deal summary (tl;dr):
- Initial scope: hosted Redwood API (text generation + embeddings) for transaction enrichment and compliance flags.
- Committed monthly tokens: 350M (Q1 ramp to steady state).
- Contract: 12 months with option to expand to Dedicated in Q3.

Key dates:
- Kickoff / technical onboarding: target week of Nov 15 (customer availability below)
- SOW signature target: Nov 12 (DocuSign link in a follow-up)

Ownership ask:
- Tessa: CS owner / primary contact for onboarding, acceptance criteria, and Go-Live readiness.
- Karthik: Implementation lead (API integration, test harness, staging validation).
- Ben: Renewal/account escalation; owns commercial channel and exec updates.
- Monica: Security/compliance contact — owns SOC2 questionnaire and any infra requirements (KMS, VPC notes).

Attachments: RDW-Corridor-SOW-v0.9.pdf (draft), Mutual_Action_Plan_Corridor.xlsx, Implementation_Checklist_v1.xlsx.

Customer notes from Sales:
- SSO via Okta required; they will share metadata during kickoff.
- Data residency: prefer us-west region; no PII storage beyond token-level logs (we documented in the SOW).
- They want a two-week staging period, then a 7-day acceptance window post-internal tests.

Next steps:
1) Tessa to propose two 60-min kickoff slots this week.
2) Karthik to validate staging capacity and confirm test account details.
3) Monica to review SOW security appendix and flag anything blocking.

Emma — feel free to add anything I missed. Tessa/Karthik/Monica — I’ll set a follow-up with the DocuSign link once Procurement confirms payment terms.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

1) Who will be the technical owner on the Corridor side (integration engineer) for API keys and sandbox access? Emma, can you confirm?
2) Does Procurement require any specific SLAs beyond the standard Redwood docs? I can loop Legal if so.
3) Do they plan to use Redwood embeddings for search-only initially or are they also previewing reranking? See SOW section 2.

Proposed kickoff slots (60 min):
- Tue Nov 16, 09:00–10:00 PT
- Wed Nov 17, 13:00–14:00 PT

Karthik — if those look ok I’ll lock the first one and prep the agenda:
- Introductions + success criteria (15m)
- Sandbox/API keys + test datasets (15m)
- Security & compliance notes (10m)
- Integration milestones & go/no-go: staging -> acceptance -> go-live (20m)

I’ll upload a slim runbook to the Drive folder and add owners to the MAP.

- Tessa

Subject: Implementation timeline & initial checklist — Corridor Finance

Morning team — thanks for the handoff. Attached is a concise timeline and the implementation checklist I’ll use to drive tasks. High level:

Week 0 (Nov 16 kickoff):
- Create staging org + API keys (Karthik)
- Okta metadata exchange (Corridor / Integration Team)
- Run a basic connectivity smoke test (Karthik + Raj)

Week 1–2 (staging validation):
- Ingest test dataset (customer)
- Verify embeddings indexing and rerank samples (test harness)
- Security checklist: KMS access pattern validated, logs retention confirmed (Monica)

Week 3 (acceptance window):
- Internal test pass -> customer validation -> acceptance sign-off
- Plan go-live for week of Dec 7 (contingent on sign-off)

Open items for the kickoff (I’ll prep slides and short runbook):
- Sandbox account names + sample dataset location (Emma/Raj)
- Exact acceptance criteria (Tessa/Emma)
- Procurement redline finalization (Grace/Ben)

Attachments: Implementation_Checklist_v1.xlsx (task owners + dates); I also added a short API test script in the Drive folder.

I’ll convert the checklist into Jira tasks after kickoff and tag owners.

—Karthik
